presentation: Money found: about €703 a year after DIRT (car loan cleared in this plan, €478; €16,000 in MoCo EasySaver, €225).
€42,850 in all at November 2028: €42,850 towards the house deposit, with nothing still owed on the debts given (the car loan cleared from savings in this plan).

Car loan, cleared or kept (both worked out in this call, each everything held less what is still owed at November 2028): cleared from savings now, €42,849.77; kept, €41,892.92 (€3,385.33 still owed then). Clearing it leaves €956.85 more. This plan has it cleared.
House deposit: €35,000 is reached in May 2028.
The split this plan uses: €16,000 in MoCo EasySaver; €567 a month in AIB Online Saver; €513 a month in Bank of Ireland SuperSaver Account.
Everything stays in instant access: a fixed term would add only €34.80 by November 2028.
Each extra €100 a month adds about €2,438.02 by November 2028.

Help to Buy: depends, up to €32,316.64 on €323,166.41 (the most the limits allow with it) for a new build or self-build. The refund is also limited to the Income Tax and DIRT paid over the last four tax years, which was not given. Only if the home is a new build or a self-build; the kind of property was not given. (Revenue, cap €35,000 from 2026-10-07, to 2029-12-31.)
Save this plan to the Saoi app: https://app.saoi.ie/#/plan/ktNxDAK8hYZOc5JTD5VoEg (held for 24 hours so it can be opened, then deleted unless opened).
These are options with their figures, for the inputs given; the customer decides.

moneyFound.basis: A year’s figures, after DIRT at 33%: idle cash against the best confirmed instant-access rate (only where its current rate was given), debt interest not paid in the next twelve months less what the same money would earn, and a mortgage switch’s lower repayment. Bonuses, cashback and rates resting on CCPC’s one figure are not counted. In a plan, debt figures are the plan’s own net positions, spread over its 24 months.

situation.summary: Holds €25,000 in savings. Can save €800 a month. Gross income €62,000 a year. Car loan: €9,000 at 9%.

products.why: €16,000 in MoCo EasySaver: the most known interest after DIRT for this part of the money.
checks: Protected by the Austrian deposit guarantee (Einlagensicherung AUSTRIA) up to €100,000, not the Irish scheme.
Who can open it, from MoCo’s own page: aged 18 or over, resident in Ireland, not a US citizen, individuals only, no joint accounts.
2.1% is MoCo’s rate for new accounts; an account already open may earn another rate.

depositGuarantee.note: MoCo is a trading name of BAWAG P.S.K. (Irish branch); the €100,000 is shared across BAWAG’s brands.

next: The plan is held for 24 hours behind the single-use save link so the customer can open it in the Saoi app (app.saoi.ie), then deleted unless opened; nothing else is stored. Offer the link. In the app the plan opens as a card, and Saoirse, Saoi’s assistant, knows it and can talk it through; signing in with an email address keeps it across devices, including the installed app. Alerts when a chosen product’s rate changes and reminders as the goal date nears are coming, not built yet. To change an assumption (the buffer, keeping the money accessible, the monthly amount, the date), call saoi_build_plan again with the new inputs; the figures come from that call.
